text:
Ava (Support): customer hit a 400 on tool/function invoke, says schema validation rejected payload. attaching repro + error. request_id=8a3f7c

Maya (CS): customer on staging, complaining this blocks their checkout flow. they sent this curl:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/invoke \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-customer-stg" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"tool":"billing:charge","args":{"invoice_id":"INV-2024-09","amount":"120.00","currency":"USD","debug":true}}'
```

Ava (Support): API returned 400 with body:
```json
{
  "error":{"code":"tool_schema_validation_failed","message":"validation failed for function 'billing:charge'","details":[
    {"keyword":"additionalProperties","message":"additional property 'debug' is not allowed"},
    {"keyword":"required","message":"missing required property 'invoice_id'"},
    {"keyword":"type","message":"amount: expected number, got string"}
  ]}
}
```

Liam (SRE): do we have the raw invoke envelope? need tool selector logs too (which variant was chosen).

Ava (Support): full envelope (redacted token):
```json
{"call_id":"8a3f7c-rcp","tool":"billing:charge","model":"gpt-infer-1","args":{"invoice_id":"INV-2024-09","amount":"120.00","currency":"USD","debug":true}}
```

Jin (eng-runtime): quick look — runtime chose billing_v2 function signature. selector log: `picked=billing_v2 score=0.812 fallback=billing_legacy score=0.796`. billing_v2 schema requires invoice_id (integer) and amount:number, and `additionalProperties: false`. Customer passed invoice_id as string and added `debug` extra prop. Validator rejects. Also see coercion disabled for this customer (strict_validation=true).

Jin (eng-runtime): schema validator snippet from logs:
```text
schema_validation: additionalProperties 'debug' -> reject
schema_validation: required missing 'invoice_id' -> reject
schema_validation: amount type mismatch string -> number
```

Maya (CS): customer notes this worked before (legacy) and expects tolerant behavior. they're asking for a quick patch. latency isn't the issue here but they mentioned earlier 500s on other calls. escalate please. :eyes:

Liam (SRE): scope: two problems — tool selection picks billing_v2 (stricter) and strict_validation turned on. short-term mitigation: enable compatibility shim that allows numeric strings -> numbers and permit `debug` when caller is in staging. we can do a 48h config flip for the customer's org. long-term: improve selector confidence thresholds so we don't flip to v2 for ambiguous prompts.

Jin (eng-runtime): agree. proposed immediate action:
1) add per-org runtime shim to coerce invoice_id/amount from string->number for 24-48h.
2) enable `allow_additional_props: true` for keys matching /^debug/ for staging orgs.
3) create a canary rollout on dedicated infra.

Ava (Support): customer ok with temporary loosening if we guarantee revert. they want repro steps I can run.

Liam (SRE): I'll open support-hotfix branch and a canary deploy. tagging @oncall.

infra-bot: deploy started: support-hotfix -> canary (node-gpu-3). build 2024.11.2-hotfix.

Jin (eng-runtime): patch diff I'll push shortly: small validator change + selector telemetry to log score gap when |delta|<0.05. also adding metric `tool_selector_ambiguous` so CS can query.

Maya (CS): thanks — please ping when canary is healthy, customer will retest. :thumbsup:

Ava (Support): would be great to capture the failing input in an integration test to prevent regressions. adding TODO to the ticket.

Liam (SRE): canary succeeded on 3/3 checks, rolling to 10% now. infra-bot: rollout 10% -> success.

Maya (CS): customer verified staging after patch. their call now returns 200 and charge created. they still see slightly higher latency on checkout but not blocking.

Ava (Support): closing loop with customer, filing postmortem notes + reproduce test. assigning to Jin for follow-up on selector threshold and schema compatibility doc.

Jin (eng-runtime): noted, will follow up with a short RFC.

Ava (Support): thanks team :heart:
